title: admin endpoint: rate limiting applied BEFORE auth check
description: In both transit/src/admin.rs and reader/src/admin.rs, the per-IP rate limiter slot is consumed before the bearer token is checked. An unauthenticated attacker can exhaust rate-limit slots for legitimate scrapers without knowing the token. The /metrics exemption path (no rate check) is correct but inconsistently documented. Maintenance consequence: contributors will copy this incorrect ordering when adding new endpoints.
